units: <cite ref="Gittin 47a:10">Gitt. 47ᵃ</cite> <he>דִּיגּוּנְךָ ולא ד׳ נכרי</he> (the word <he>דגנך</he>, <cite ref="Deuteronomy 14:23">Deut. XIV, 23</cite> means) what thou (the Israelite) storest up (is subject to tithes), but not what the gentile stores up, opp. to <he>דְּגָנְךָ וכ׳</he> the grain growing on thy ground (Palestine).
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 88b">B. Mets. 88ᵇ</cite> <he>בני ד׳</he> Ms. F. (ed. <cite ref="C00498"><he>גורן</he></cite>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 100) adapted for storage.
